items.source: Trigger processing of the test classes by clearing output directories first and then performing AOT processing.
items.translation: 通过首先清除输出目录，然后执行 AOT 处理来触发测试类的处理。

items.source: Scan the configured classpath roots for Spring integration test classes.
items.translation: 扫描已配置的 类路径根目录 以查找 Spring 集成测试类。

items.source:
Concrete implementations are typically used to kick off optimization of a
test suite in a build tool.
items.translation: 具体实现通常用于在构建工具中启动测试套件的优化。

items.source:
Code, resources, and generated classes are stored in the configured
output directories. In addition, run-time hints are registered for the
application contexts used by the test classes as well as test infrastructure
components used by the tests.
items.translation: 代码、资源和生成的类存储在配置的输出目录中。此外，还为测试类使用的应用上下文以及测试使用的测试基础设施组件注册了运行时提示。

items.source:
Create a new processor for the specified test classpath roots and
common settings.
items.translation: 为指定的测试类路径根目录和通用设置创建一个新的处理器。

items.source: Get the classpath roots to scan for test classes.
items.translation: 获取用于扫描测试类的类路径根目录。

items.source: doProcess in class AbstractAotProcessor<Void>
items.translation: doProcess 类 AbstractAotProcessor<Void>

items.source: classpathRoots - the classpath roots to scan for test classes
items.translation: classpathRoots - 要扫描以查找测试类的类路径根目录

items.source: a stream of Spring integration test classes
Perform ahead-of-time processing of Spring integration test classes.
items.translation: 执行 Spring 集成测试类的提前处理。
